feeds.title: Life With Herpes Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Alexandra Harbushka. I'm here to teach you everything that there is to know about the virus. From the 101 on the HSV virus to the home remedies, the prescriptions, and much much more. In other words, I want to tell the truth about what it is like to really live with herpes. I promise, your life is not over. Your life is not a stigma. I know this to be true because I was and am no longer in fear of that.
